---
title: "Install"
---

*Written for version 0.1.5. Commands checked on 10 November 2026; see [What's been tested](testing.qmd) for exactly how. Menus change; if what you see differs, tell the maintainer through a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/figure-design/issues).*

Installing the plugin gives the assistant instructions only. It adds no access to your files, accounts or computer; what the assistant can reach is set in the app.

The repository is its own marketplace (a marketplace is a list of plugins kept in a GitHub repository), so every route below starts from `VagishHemmige/figure-design`.

Pick the assistant you use.

## Claude (on the web, the desktop app or Cowork)

You need a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise).

**Add the plugin's marketplace:**

1. In Claude, open **Settings**, then **Customize**.
2. Open the **Plugins** tab.
3. Click **Add**, then **Add marketplace**.
4. Choose **Add from a repository**.
5. Type `VagishHemmige/figure-design` and confirm.

If your organization limits which marketplaces you can add, Claude will refuse it; ask your administrator.

**Install the plugin:**

6. Still in **Customize** → **Plugins**, open the **Discover** tab.
7. Select **Interactive Figure Design** and click **Add**.

These are the same steps as for [R Analysis Workflow](https://vagishhemmige.github.io/r-analysis-workflow/install.html), which has screenshots. Source: Anthropic, [Use plugins in Claude](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13837440-use-plugins-in-claude). Not yet tried in the Claude app with this plugin.

## Claude Code

You need Claude Code version 2.1.292 or later for the one-line install. In your terminal (not inside a Claude Code session):

```bash
claude plugin install figure-design --marketplace VagishHemmige/figure-design
```

On an older version, use two commands instead:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add VagishHemmige/figure-design
claude plugin install figure-design@figure-design
```

To check, run `claude plugin list`: you should see `figure-design@figure-design`. The plugin loads the next time you start Claude Code. To update later:

```bash
claude plugin update figure-design@figure-design
```

Sources: Claude Code docs, [Install and manage plugins](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/install) and [Create a marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces).

## Codex

In your terminal:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add VagishHemmige/figure-design
codex plugin add figure-design@figure-design
```

To check, run `codex plugin list`: you should see `figure-design@figure-design` as `installed, enabled`. To pick up a new version, run `codex plugin marketplace upgrade figure-design`.

Source: OpenAI, [Build plugins](https://developers.openai.com/codex/plugins/build).

## ChatGPT

In ChatGPT you make the plugin with OpenAI's **Plugin Creator**, pointing it at this repository. Whether Plugin Creator is available depends on your plan and workspace.

1. Start a new conversation.
2. Type `@`, search for **Plugin Creator**, and select it.
3. Ask it, in your own words: *Create a plugin from https://github.com/VagishHemmige/figure-design.*
4. Answer its questions and follow its prompts. Check that the name is **Interactive Figure Design**.

**Use it:** in a new conversation, type `@`, start typing "Interactive Figure Design", and select it under **Plugins**.

Not yet tried from this repository. The plugin was first built in ChatGPT, and the same route works for [R Analysis Workflow](https://vagishhemmige.github.io/r-analysis-workflow/install.html#chatgpt).
